name: ZX_THREHLDS_SCHDL_CNTRLS_F
description: This table contains detail information about thresholds for tax and jurisdictions.

columns.name: TAX_THREHLDS_SCHDL_CNTRL_ID
columns.description: Column to uniquely identify the tax threshold and schedule controls.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Configuration owner of the tax detail record.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code for the classification of a charge imposed by a government through a fiscal or tax authority.

columns.name: TAX_THREHLDS_SCHDL_CNTRL_CODE
columns.description: Code to identify the tax threshold and schedules control record.

columns.name: MIN_TAXABLE_THRSHLD
columns.description: Minimum taxable threshold limit of the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: MAX_TAXABLE_THRSHLD
columns.description: Maximum taxable threshold limit of the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: MIN_TAX_THRSHLD
columns.description: Minimum tax threshold limit of the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: MAX_TAX_THRSHLD
columns.description: Maximum tax threshold limit of the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: MIN_RATE_THRSHLD
columns.description: Minimum rate threshold limit of the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: MAX_RATE_THRSHLD
columns.description: Maximum rate threshold limit of the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code on the tax threshold controls.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for the tax detail.

columns.name: THRSHLD_SCHEDULE_GRP_LVL_FLAG
columns.description: Threshold schedule group level. Possible values are: L (line for transaction tax), D (document for transaction tax or withholding tax), P (period for withholding tax), U (per unit) and S (set).

columns.name: CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Name of tax calendar defined in ZX_CALENDARS. Used when the schedule basis is set to "period".

columns.name: SCHEDULE_APPLICATION_FLAG
columns.description: Schedule application. Possible values are M (multiple rates depending upon amount ranges) and S (single rate on entire taxable basis).

columns.name: TXBL_BSIS_THRSHLD_HNDLNG_FLAG
columns.description: Taxable basis threshold handling. Possible values are E (amount exceeding minimum taxable threshold) and F (full amount).

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OPERATOR_CODE
